subject: Post-discovery: scheduling 30-min intro & attendee handoff
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@meridianbio.com>, Priyanka Singh <priyanka.singh@meridianbio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: scheduling 30-min intro & attendee handoff

Hi Alex / Priyanka — thanks again for a productive intro call today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

- What we heard: you want to evaluate Redwood to reduce latency for customer-facing prompt workloads and test a pilot around privacy controls for PHI-like data flows.
- Key success criteria you shared: sub-300ms P95 on short prompts, audit logs retained 90+ days, and an integration pattern that avoids sending raw PII to third-party services.

Next step: 30-min product intro (short demo + Q&A) focused on the runtime, auth/KMS options, and basic rollout patterns. Can you pick 1 preferred slot from the three options below (all ET) or propose two that work better? I’ll loop in our solutions engineer for the technical portion.

Option A — Tue Jun 24, 11:00–11:30 AM ET
Option B — Wed Jun 25, 2:30–3:00 PM ET
Option C — Thu Jun 26, 9:00–9:30 AM ET

Agenda (30m): 5m recap + goal alignment, 15m demo (runtime + security controls), 10m Q&A and next steps. 

Attachments: redwood_onepager.pdf (one-pager), mutual_action_plan.xlsx (starter MAP).

If any legal/procurement folks should join for a quick pricing orientation, flag them in your reply and we’ll include a pricing summary.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference runtime.

- We can confirm the pilot focus and criteria you captured.
- Preferred slots: Option B (Wed 2:30 PM ET) looks best for the product/engineering team. Option A is also possible if we need an earlier check-in.
- We’ll have Priyanka (Infrastructure lead) and I on the call; I also want to invite our security lead briefly — she may join depending on timing.

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Meridian Bio — confirm SE coverage + demo prep

Ben / Mina — quick internal note after the discovery with Meridian: they validated the pilot goals and want a 30-min intro focused on runtime latency and security/audit controls. Alex prefers Wed Jun 25 at 2:30 PM ET (Option B).

Ask:
- Mina: can you cover the audit logs + key rotation demo (3–5 minutes) and be prepared to talk about KMS/HSM integrations?
- Ben: please own the calendar invite and include the MAP (mutual_action_plan.xlsx) and the one-pager. Add me + Mina + Alex + Priyanka in the invite; mark the event as product-demo:30m.

Prep notes:
- Bring a quick slide or console demo to show P95 token latencies on a short prompt (we can use the sample model/test vectors I uploaded to our shared drive).
- Keep pricing comments high-level; legal/procurement will likely request more detail later.

I’ll confirm with Alex once you can commit.

Thanks — Naomi

Alex / Priyanka — confirmed: Wed Jun 25, 2:30–3:00 PM ET for the 30-min intro. Ben just sent the calendar invite (should arrive in your inbox shortly) — please accept when you have a moment.

Final agenda: 5m recap & goals, 15m demo (runtime performance + deployment model), 5m audit logs & key rotation (Mina), 5m Q&A / next steps.

Prep for the call: if you can share one representative prompt or short workload we should test during the demo, please paste it in reply or attach a small text file — we’ll use it to show end-to-end latency and cache behavior.

Next steps after the demo: quick follow-up to propose a small pilot and a mutual-action plan timeline.

See you Wednesday — Naomi
